title: Comment helper record: new recipe + 1:1 rules - Publish / Hold; Giacomo Balli to HubSpot
summary:
From your Nov 18 1:1 and the new comment recipe. Staged on overnight-2026-11-18 (commit 538754f), not live.

**Section 4 is now the comment recipe:** every comment has one real story from your story bank AND a pattern name; the name comes up inside the story the way you'd say it; never "We call it X"; no neat closing line; some comments push back on part of the post; vary the shape (one line some days, three others; sometimes reply to another commenter; humor now and then); no questions to the author; never invent a story. The story bank is pointed at by its private address only - nothing from it is in this repo. Kept: regular dashes, pattern names, your two stances, the COBOL / Smalltalk / Java rotation (twice a week at most).

**New section - Weekly 1:1 (Wednesdays 9 AM):** warm replies (a real back-and-forth) are proposed as HubSpot contacts on this form - contact only, no deal, you approve; before each 1:1 you give the week's reply and profile-visit counts and the helper scores itself on them.

**First warm reply:** Giacomo Balli (independent tech advisor to business owners) - the handoff drill thread, Nov 11. Proposed as a HubSpot contact only, no deal. If you approve, it's done in the marketing helper's live HubSpot session (the night run doesn't write to HubSpot).

questions.text: Giacomo Balli as a HubSpot contact (no deal)
